lanes.summary: Diff matches both tickets. PMAT-4380: ~10 producer build.rs files (aprender-core, aprender-compute, aprender-db, aprender-orchestrate, aprender-present-cli/core, aprender-rag, aprender-serve, aprender-simulate, aprender-train) switch from the gone `../../../provable-contracts` sibling path to in-tree `contracts/<crate>/binding.yaml`, and now panic (monorepo-only, crates.io fallback preserved) if `contracts/` exists but the per-crate binding.yaml is missing. Two dead build.rs stubs (aprender-graph, aprender-verify) and the equally-dead provable-contracts block in aprender-verify-ml's build.rs are deleted — verified these never emitted any CONTRACT_* env var, so the deletion is not a gate weakening. aprender-serve's arch-requirements/tensor-names/arch-constraints paths are fixed the same way, plus new hard-fail assertions when a YAML read/parse fails in-monorepo. Three aprender-serve #[contract] sites are renamed (gemm-v1/forward-pass-v1/sampling-v1 → matmul/rmsnorm/softmax-kernel-v1) and matching rows exist in the restored/backfilled realizar binding.yaml, so the env-var lookup (keyed by contract+equation only) resolves. The contracts-macros hardening (#4368 registry_miss compile_error, #2699 fail-closed condition parsing) ships unit tests with real case tables (registry_miss_is_an_error_only_when_the_registry_ran, read_contract_assertions_fails_closed_on_what_a_producer_emitted), and a new `contract_env_key!` proc-macro is tested for parity against the producer-side `env_key` (env_key_equals_the_key_the_contract_macro_reads). Every touched crate gets a `contract_binding_registry_is_loaded` test pinning CONTRACT_BINDING_SOURCE=binding.yaml. PMAT-4581: the `[profile.dev.package.sha2] opt-level = 3` addition is a narrowly-scoped, well-justified Cargo.toml change; the cbtop M001-M003/M007/M008/M010 tests are correctly moved from a per-test `cargo run` invocation to `crates/apr-cli/tests/falsification_cbtop_measurement.rs` using CARGO_BIN_EXE_apr, with the SKIP arms and `if success` guards removed as the ticket describes, and no dangling Command:: residue left in the old include file. verify-ml's book oracle tests now skip cleanly (stderr reason) without python3, and assert with `.expect()` (stronger than the old `assert!(result.is_ok())`) when it is present. I could not find any changed lines removing entries from `ALLOWED_GAPS` in crates/aprender-core/build.rs (the ticket's fourth acceptance criterion) — reading the file directly at HEAD confirms it still only lists 3 `ssm-kernel-v1` entries, none of which correspond to a binding.yaml row that exists at all (so none is "implemented" either — the criterion's literal wording is still satisfied, just not by any pruning in this diff). The ticket's own status is `in_progress`/50%, so this reads as an open acceptance item carried forward, not a false completion claim, and it does not refute anything the diff does claim. The new `falsification_cbtop_measurement.rs` integration-test target is not named in any `ci/explicit-test-commands.d/*.cmd` fragment, but neither was the old `aprender-core/tests/falsification_measurement_tests.rs` it replaced — so this is pre-existing CI-dark status carried over, not a new regression introduced by the move. No test asserts the opposite of a ticket, no existing gate is weakened, and I found no work outside the scope of the two tickets.

findings.claim: Acceptance criterion 'no ALLOWED_GAPS entry in crates/aprender-core/build.rs names a binding whose status is implemented' is listed, but the diff makes zero changes to the ALLOWED_GAPS list itself; verified by reading crates/aprender-core/build.rs at HEAD, which still lists exactly the same 3 ssm-kernel-v1 entries.
findings.failure_scenario: Not a functional bug and not a false completion claim (ticket status is in_progress/50%), but a reviewer skimming the title 'dead ALLOWED_GAPS pruned' could believe this diff performed a prune it did not perform.
findings.fix: No fix required for this diff; leave as an open acceptance-criterion item for a follow-up commit on this in-progress ticket.

findings.claim: The new integration-test target is not referenced by any ci/explicit-test-commands.d/*.cmd fragment, so it does not run in CI's workspace-test job.
findings.failure_scenario: M001/M002/M003/M007/M008/M010 silently stop being exercised by CI (though this matches the pre-existing dark status of the file they were moved from, so it's not a new regression from this diff).
findings.fix: Add a fragment such as ci/explicit-test-commands.d/NNN-apr-cli-cbtop-measurement.cmd naming `--test falsification_cbtop_measurement`, in a follow-up.

lanes.summary: Diff matches both tickets. PMAT-4380: build.rs producers across ~10 crates (aprender-core, aprender-compute, aprender-db, aprender-serve, aprender-orchestrate, aprender-present-cli/core, aprender-rag, aprender-simulate, aprender-train, aprender-verify-ml) switch from the dead `../../../provable-contracts/contracts/...` sibling path to the in-tree `contracts/<crate>/binding.yaml`, and now hard-panic when `contracts/` exists in the workspace but the per-crate binding.yaml is missing, while preserving the crates.io/no-workspace graceful fallback. Dead stub build.rs files (aprender-graph, aprender-verify) and the vestigial provable-contracts block in aprender-verify-ml/build.rs are deleted. New/restored binding.yaml registries (aprender, batuta, entrenar, presentar, realizar, simular, trueno, trueno-db, trueno-rag) plus contracts.nt are added consistently — the setfit-encoder-conformance-v1 rows for `BertSentenceEncoder::forward_tokens` and `pair_cosine_mse` are present as the ticket claims, and the #4369 backfill rows are explicitly marked `status: partial` / "unaudited". The contracts-macros hardening (#4368 `registry_miss` compile_error, #2699 fail-closed condition parsing via `Expr`, `contract_env_key!` parity with `aprender-contracts::build_helper::env_key`) is additive, and both crates carry case-table unit tests covering the sentinel-present/absent and malformed-condition branches. The renamed `#[contract]` sites in `aprender-serve/src/gguf/ops.rs` (`forward-pass-v1`→`rmsnorm-kernel-v1`, `sampling-v1`→`softmax-kernel-v1`) match rows now present in the restored `contracts/realizar/binding.yaml`, and the new `contract_pre_constraint_matrix_exhaustiveness!()` call added to generated `arch_requirements.rs` corresponds to a registered equation in that same file and in contracts.nt. PMAT-4581: the `[profile.dev.package.sha2] opt-level = 3` Cargo.toml addition is scoped and documented with measured before/after numbers; the cbtop M001-M003/M007/M008/M010 tests are faithfully moved to `crates/apr-cli/tests/falsification_cbtop_measurement.rs` using `CARGO_BIN_EXE_apr` (removing the "apr binary not found" skip arms, which is correct since the binary is now a build input of that target) while the source file they were removed from has no dangling `Command::` usage; verify-ml's book oracle tests gain a `python_or_skip` guard that still asserts strictly when python3 is present and prints a SKIP reason when absent, matching the sovereign-ci fix rationale. The "dead ALLOWED_GAPS pruned" acceptance criterion is not visible as changed lines in this diff (plausibly already satisfied by a prior commit already merged into this branch per the roadmap entry's phrasing and recent commit history) — this is a documentation/traceability soft spot rather than a code defect. No test asserts the opposite of either ticket, no gate is weakened, and I found no out-of-scope or forbidden work.
